# body-highlighter 3.0.2

- Package: body-highlighter 3.0.2 (MIT)
- Publisher: lahaxearnaud; upstream license copyright: GV79, 2020.
- Source repository: https://github.com/lahaxearnaud/body-highlighter
- Published package: https://registry.npmjs.org/body-highlighter/-/body-highlighter-3.0.2.tgz
- Published CJS file: package/dist/body-highlighter.cjs.js
- SHA-256 of the original published CJS file: fff86f7b4d9c2753256499f55a4d7f5ba320260a03998651e3a81298c5d184ff
- The published CJS source has no external imports, network APIs, eval, or Function constructor. It is retained unchanged in this directory.
- body-highlighter.browser.js wraps that source in a local module/exports closure and exposes only createBodyHighlighter, MuscleType, and ModelType as window.AstraBodyHighlighter. The source-map comment is omitted from the adapted copy. This permits classic script loading from both file:// and local HTTP without a package manager, runtime CDN, eval, or general bundler.
- The UI uses this muscle-group silhouette only for conceptual Brain/head, Heart/chest, and Whole body navigation. It does not depict or measure brain/heart organs.
